# Style Manual
The standard for Australian Government writing and editing

The Style Manual is for everyone who writes, edits or approves Australian Government content.

Use the Style Manual when creating Australian Government content.

They will help you style Australian Government content consistently.

- [Design for accessibility and inclusion](https://www.stylemanual.gov.au/accessible-and-inclusive-content/design-accessibility-and-inclusion)
- [Writing and designing content](https://www.stylemanual.gov.au/writing-and-designing-content)

Reference this section for definitive rules and examples of Australian Government style.
